_metadata.source_notebook_sha: (unverified - upstream repo has no LICENSE; outputs derived per CONTEXT.md re-route D-17 + 01-01-SPIKE-NOTES.md)
_metadata.rationale: JackJacquier/SSVI ships only a Jupyter notebook with no LICENSE. Per CONTEXT.md re-route D-17, executing the notebook against pinned inputs and capturing outputs into this fixture is the documented path. For Plan 01-08 the expected_w values are derived from deepvault.svi.total_variance(svi, k) on these inputs - this is a Tier C 'stub' cross-check that asserts the SHAPE of the cross-check pipeline (loader + per-row tolerance + notebook-style assertion) without externally-verified ground truth. A future plan can overwrite the expected_w values with notebook-captured outputs (recompute via Jupyter against pinned commit SHA) without changing the loader/test harness.
_metadata.tolerance: 5 units at FLOAT_SCALING=1e9 (notebook would use float arithmetic; bit-equality is not expected even after notebook capture).
_metadata.schema: Each row: {id: string, svi: {a, b, rho, m, sigma at FLOAT_SCALING=1e9}, k: int at FLOAT_SCALING, expected_w: int at FLOAT_SCALING, tolerance: int, comment: string}
_metadata.future_work: Phase 6 whitepaper closeout: (a) execute upstream notebook against the 5 svi/k tuples below, (b) capture outputs to this file with notebook git SHA pinned, (c) confirm tolerance window holds against deepvault.svi outputs.
